Dogecoin tumbles after Elon Musk calls it a ‘hustle’ on ‘SNL’ show

Sources say that Aziz McMahon, a managing director and head of emerging market sales at Goldman Sachs in London, has resigned, allegedly after making money on Dogecoin the cryptocurrency championed by Elon Musk whose value rose 72 times.
